title: Chapter 1435 - 11: Lin Yuan'S Future Self (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1435 - 11: Lin Yuan'S Future Self (Part 2)

Chapter 1435 - 11: Lin Yuan's Future Self (Part 2)

As long as you avoid a direct hit from the 'Annihilation Horn', the Time Lord absolutely cannot launch a second strike with the 'Annihilation Horn'.

But that is the normal way a Blood Sea Lord would respond to this move.

At this moment, his future self overlooks the battlefield and naturally doesn't need to be so cautious.

Rustle.

Behind the Blood Sea Lord, the vast red silhouette's robes naturally spread out, transforming into a blood-red canopy, actively warding off the Time Lord's strike from the 'Annihilation Horn'.

"Sizzle sizzle sizzle~" The twisted annihilation force melted away rapidly upon contact with the blood-red canopy, like water meeting fire, constantly colliding and dissolving.

However, compared to the endless blood-red canopy, the twisted annihilation force was evidently somewhat 'weak and lonely'. At the beginning of the clash, both sides could still contend with each other, but after just a few breaths, the twisted annihilation force began to show signs of decline.

After a dozen breaths, the blood-red canopy was still overwhelming, but the annihilation force of the twisted space-time was nearly depleted.

After twenty breaths, the blood-red canopy occupied all of space-time, and the annihilation force completely dispersed.

"What?"

"The Time Lord's strongest killing move was blocked just like that?"

Even though this outcome had been somewhat anticipated, the Time Lords present were still shocked. The twisted power emanating from the 'Annihilation Horn' was enough to make the scalp tingle of those who had reached the legendary threshold of the Time Lords.

And yet, it could only last twenty breaths under the blood-red canopy?

"Hahaha."

Overlooking the Time Lord, the Blood Sea Lord smiled and said, "Time Lord, your strongest killing move doesn't seem that impressive?"

"Are you not afraid of the supreme will's backlash acting so recklessly?" The Time Lord frowned, looking at the vast red silhouette behind the Blood Sea Lord.

This vast red silhouette was surrounded by temporal power, at odds with this space-time.

"Backlash?"

The vast red silhouette chuckled softly, saying no more.

The next moment.

The blood-red canopy around the vast red silhouette suddenly converged, heading toward the Time Lord.

The immense force tilted, causing space-time to continually collapse. Even the ultimate space-time of Wanwei was hard-pressed to contain the strength of a legendary lord.

"The future of the Blood Sea Lord's legendary body has made its move."

"What is this technique? I've never seen it from the Blood Sea Lord before."

"When the Blood Sea Lord becomes a legend in the future, he will certainly create many killing moves, how could you have seen them before?"

The Time Lords observing the battle conversed among themselves, witnessing a true legendary being in action was indeed rewarding.

Swoosh!

The blood-red canopy surged forward, engulfing the Time Lord instantly.

The Time Lord felt engulfed in blood from all directions, losing his sense of the external world, and even the connection with his true self became significantly blurred.

"Break for me!"

The Time Lord struggled desperately, yet every bit of strength he exerted was like sinking into a quagmire, even beginning to penetrate into his physical body with the aura of the blood-red ocean.

"Is this the power of legend?"

There was a chill in the Time Lord's heart, unable to even destroy this main battle body under the influence of the blood-red ocean's power.

"This loss is substantial."

The Time Lord was troubled.

If it was just losing a main battle body, he could still accept it.

But having the main battle body fall into the Blood Sea Lord's hands... it was far more than a simple loss of a main battle body.

The Time Lord's numerous secret techniques could potentially be unraveled from the main battle body. The consequences of it falling into the enemy's hands are self-evident.

Moreover, using the main battle body, many causal methods could be employed, posing another significant threat to the Time Lord.

"Who knows how much it will cost this time to redeem this main battle body."

The Time Lord sighed.

He wasn't redeeming the main battle body, but his own hidden dangers.

This was far beyond what thousands of pounds of the sands of time could compare to.

"There's no other way, I'll just annihilate the mind consciousness within this main battle body."

As the body gradually lost control, the Time Lord immediately chose to annihilate his own mind intent.

Under the influence of the blood-red ocean's power, the Time Lord lost control of his physical body, but his mind intent could still be completely dominated.

If a complete piece of his mind intent were to fall into the Blood Sea Lord's hands, then the Time Lord estimated there was even a possibility he could be enslaved by the other party.

...

Outside.

The crimson ocean converged, forming a deep blood pearl the size of a fist.

The blood pearl floated before the Blood Sea Lord, slowly rotating.

"The main battle body of the Time Lord Tianshi is inside it."

The imposing scarlet figure glanced at the Blood Sea Lord and spoke.

"Inside it?"

The Blood Sea Lord was overjoyed in his heart.

Capturing the main battle body of the Time Lord Tianshi alive would bring many benefits and could somewhat leverage the Time Lord Tianshi.

"I can exist in this spacetime for ten breaths. After ten breaths, I will return to the original spacetime," the imposing scarlet figure continued.

Having descended from the future to this spacetime and acted, it would suffer backlash suppression.

The timeline's instinctive repairing force would expel Him back to the original spacetime.

"Moreover, my actions have already attracted the attention of a few old fellows from the deepest part of Wanwei spacetime. You must leave here within a hundred breaths."

The imposing scarlet figure added.

"A few old fellows from the deepest part?"

The Blood Sea Lord's pupils contracted. To be called "old fellows" by a future self who had already entered the legendary domain, they must be Legendary Lords.

"Ten breaths, no problem."

The Blood Sea Lord looked around, and at this moment, twenty to thirty Time Lords had already gathered nearby.

"Gentlemen, you now have two choices."

The Blood Sea Lord said, "One is for the main battle bodies to perish, and the other is for each of you to hand over ten million jins of Time Sand."

The reason for not capturing the main battle bodies of so many Time Lords alive, as with the Time Lord Tianshi, is because their time far exceeds the latter's.

The future self of the Blood Sea Lord could only continue existing for ten breaths, not having the time to capture them one by one.

"Only five breaths to consider, after which I'll take action."

The Blood Sea Lord spoke in a calm tone.

"Hand over ten million jins of Time Sand?"

The multitude of Time Lords looked grim. They wanted to escape, but found that the scarlet power had long permeated the surrounding area.

In fact, as soon as the future self of the Blood Sea Lord descended into this spacetime, it had already sealed off the surrounding area, and the Lords within range could not escape.

"I am willing to hand over ten million jins of Time Sand."

"I am also willing to hand it over."

"Ten million jins of Time Sand? Blood Sea Lord, you're dreaming."

...

Within three to four breaths, most Time Lords made their choice. Some accepted, while others refused, instantly extinguishing their main battle bodies.

Five breaths passed.

Only a few Time Lords on the field had not yet given a response.

Among these Time Lords was Lin Yuan.

Compared to the hesitant and uncertain Time Lords, Lin Yuan fixed his gaze on the Blood Sea Lord and the imposing scarlet figure behind him, his mind continuously colliding with countless inspirations and insights.

"You all..."

The Blood Sea Lord scanned Lin Yuan and the other undecided Lords.

Swoosh.

The scarlet aura continued to gather, clearly preparing to directly extinguish the main battle bodies of these Lords.

The other Time Lords who disagreed did not even wait for the Blood Sea Lord to act and extinguished their own main battle bodies.

But Lin Yuan and the others, having not made a decision, showed no signs of extinguishing their bodies.

Therefore, the Blood Sea Lord intended to act personally.

"Blood Sea Lord."

At this moment, Lin Yuan suddenly spoke, looking at the high and mighty Blood Sea Lord and the imposing scarlet figure behind: "I want to know, in your spacetime, has any Lord achieved transcendence?"

As soon as this remark was made, the other Time Lords were stunned, turning to look at Lin Yuan, not expecting him to ask such a question at this moment.

"Hmm?"

The Blood Sea Lord was also taken aback.

But immediately understood that Lin Yuan was not asking himself, but the future self who had stepped into the legendary level.

"Transcendence?" The imposing scarlet figure looked down at Lin Yuan, as the scarlet aura intertwined. The more He observed Lin Yuan, the more His expression grew uncertain and puzzled.
